definitions.explanation: A device that generates and sends out signals, especially radio waves. Contrasts with a receiver, which picks the signals up.

examples.japanese: {送信機|そうしんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{無線|むせん}→無線：09226_musen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送信機|そうしんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}した→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧。
⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送信機|そうしんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遠|とお}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧。
examples.english: to send radio waves far away using a small transmitter.

notes:
Used for radio, telemetry, and remote-control equipment that emits signals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{無線|むせん}→無線：09226_musen⟧{送信機|そうしんき}: wireless transmitter
- {送信機|そうしんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a transmitter
- {送信機|そうしんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出力|しゅつりょく}→出力：04771_shutsuryoku⟧: the output power of a transmitter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受信機|じゅしんき}→受信機：23942_jushinki⟧: receiver — the device that picks up the signal (the antonym)
- {発信機|はっしんき}: beacon; signal emitter — emphasizes giving off a locating signal
